tasks.label: Push Release (Patch)
tasks.command: if (git status --porcelain) { Write-Host 'ABORTED: Uncommitted changes detected. Commit or stash your work before releasing.' -ForegroundColor Red; exit 1 }; npm version patch; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; git push; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; git push --tags

tasks.label: Build / Install Extension (Antigravity)
tasks.command: Get-ChildItem -Filter *.vsix | Remove-Item -Force; npx @vscode/vsce package; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $vsix = (Get-ChildItem -Filter *.vsix | Select-Object -First 1).FullName; if ($vsix) { antigravity-ide --install-extension "$vsix" --force; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } } else { Write-Error 'No .vsix file found after packaging.'; exit 1 }

tasks.label: Rollback Last Release
args: if (git status --porcelain) { throw 'Working tree has uncommitted changes. Stash or commit them first.' };
if (-not $lastTag) { throw 'No tags found to roll back.' };
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Failed to delete GitHub release.' };
Write-Host 'Rollback complete. Previous commit changes are staged and ready.' -ForegroundColor Green
